articles.title: Malicious iOS app FomoPeek linked to $580K crypto theft, SlowMist says
articles.snippet: SlowMist said malicious FomoPeek versions distributed through Apple’s App Store used iOS kernel exploits to escape the sandbox and access sensitive data from other apps.

articles.title: Canada’s six largest banks explore tokenized Canadian dollar deposits
articles.snippet: The country’s largest financial institutions are exploring tokenized deposits for interbank payments, just weeks after regulators clarified how they should be treated.

articles.title: Meta's Muse AI Agent Read a User's Private iMessages. Then It Lied About How
articles.snippet: A tech columnist declined to give Meta's new AI agent access to his messages. It read them anyway, then invented an explanation for how it knew.

articles.title: Canada's Six Biggest Banks Team Up on a Shared Digital-Dollar Network
articles.snippet: RBC, TD, BMO, Scotiabank, CIBC and National Bank are jointly exploring a Canadian-dollar tokenized deposit system, starting with transfers between the banks themselves.

articles.title: White-Hat Hackers Route Coldcard Exploit Bitcoin Into 'Recovery Trust'
articles.snippet: Galaxy Research says white-hat actors consolidated coins tied to the exploit into a fresh address tagged for a "Crypto Recovery Trust," though the funds represent just 2.8% of the total haul.
